A failed '''Jedi''' was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] problem, and considered [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] to be a necessity of life.<ref name="RPG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|No bar for kilometers around?''"<br />"''I'm afraid so.''"<br />"''Okay, I use my survival skill to look for booze.''"<br />"''Your survival skill?''"<br />"''Says here you can use it to find the necessities of life.''"<br />"''I don't think&hellip;''"<br />"''I'm telling you, liquor's a necessity of life for me.|A failed Jedi player character and the gamemaster disagree over the use of the survival skill|<ref name="RPG" />}}
The failed Jedi appeared in [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']] in an example of how a player character could&mdash;or, in this case, could ''not''&mdash;use the survival skill.<ref name="RPG" />
